banned_strategies: exploiting price errors / delayed or external feeds
opposite positions across accounts or with other traders

EAs causing >2,000 server requests per day
overleveraging, overexposure, one-sided bets, account rolling
hedging or splitting trades to get around the Best Day / Consistency rule
